basic_info.description: New price! Located in the heart of vibrant Hayes Valley, this stylish two-bedroom, one-bath condo is part of a boutique, well-maintained six-unit building. Sunlight pours through large south-facing windows overlooking Hayes Street, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The updated kitchen is a chef's delight with quartz countertops, maple cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range  perfect for both cooking and entertaining. Bamboo floors, crown molding, recessed lighting, and a cozy gas fireplace add warmth and character throughout.  The thoughtful floor plan features two generous bedrooms, a modern bathroom with a custom vanity and shower-over-tub, and ample storage. A shared roofdeck with panoramic city views, one-car parking, private storage and in-building laundry complete the offering. With a walkscore of 100, you are a stone throw from shops, businesses, SF Jazz center, public transportation options and 101 freeway. A rare find for the urbanite!
